newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 858 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 858 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 858 contracts compared with 1,773 overnight Tuesday.
There were 52 wheat, 181 corn, 541 soybean, 56 soymeal, 11 soyoil, three oat, eight soybean calls and six soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was unchanged to 1/2 cent higher, corn was 1/4 to 1/2 cent higher and soybeans were 2-1/4 cents higher to two cents lower.
